tagline.zh: 从月历网格里点选日期:触发器收起为输入框,展开后是「星期表头 + 7 列日网格 + 月份切换」的浮层面板。
tagline.en: Pick a date from a month grid: the trigger collapses into an input, opening a panel of 'weekday header + 7-column day grid + month paging'.

origin.zh: APG 没有独立 date picker 模式,官方示例(Dialog 版日期选择器)以 grid 模式承载月历:role=grid/row/gridcell 组织行列,方向键在网格内移动(调研 07§34 的 30 模式清单含 Grid);本条目 demo 为**自绘简化实现**,仅取其网格思想。生产参照系是 Ant Design DatePicker(antd 6.7.1 核对:size 默认不设=32px/large 40px/small 24px(官方文档明示三个高度)、allowClear 默认 true、placement 默认 bottomLeft、默认 en-US locale 经 ConfigProvider 挂 zh_CN,见设计调研 06§4.9)。
origin.en: APG has no standalone date picker pattern; its official example (the dialog-based date picker) carries the month calendar on the grid pattern: role=grid/row/gridcell for rows and columns with arrow keys moving inside the grid (Grid is in the 30-pattern list of research 07 §34). This entry's demo is a **self-drawn simplified implementation** borrowing only the grid idea. The production reference is Ant Design DatePicker (antd 6.7.1: size unset=32px / large 40px / small 24px (three heights documented explicitly), allowClear default true, placement bottomLeft, en-US locale default with zh_CN via ConfigProvider — design study 06 §4.9).

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后重排星期表头与日网格)。周一始为中国大陆与 ISO 8601 惯例,周日始为北美惯例;组件库通常随 locale 决定(antd 经 locale 挂载,zh_CN/en-US 各随其周起始约定),demo 默认 mon 与默认 lang zh 配对。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and re-orders the weekday header and day grid). Monday-first is the mainland-China and ISO 8601 convention, Sunday-first the North-American one; libraries typically derive it from locale (antd mounts it via locale, zh_CN/en-US each following their own week-start convention). The demo defaults to mon, paired with lang zh.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切换月标题/星期表头/按钮文案)。对齐组件库的 i18n 机制:antd DatePicker 默认 en-US,经 ConfigProvider locale 挂 zh_CN(设计调研 06§4.9);demo 的日期格式 zh 用 2026年11月21日、en 用 Nov 21, 2026。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and switches month title / weekday header / button copy). Aligns with library i18n mechanics: antd DatePicker defaults to en-US with zh_CN mounted via ConfigProvider locale (design study 06 §4.9); demo date formats are 2026年11月21日 for zh and Nov 21, 2026 for en.

effect.zh: JS 型参数(demo 订阅后切 data-size,作用于触发器高度与日格尺寸)。对应 antd DatePicker 官方文档明示的三档高度:size 默认不设=32px、large=40px、small=24px(设计调研 06§4.9)。
effect.en: JS-type param (demo subscribes and toggles data-size, driving trigger height and day-cell size). Maps to the three heights documented explicitly by antd DatePicker: size unset=32px, large=40px, small=24px (design study 06 §4.9).

note.zh: demo 的月历网格全部用原生 button + ARIA grid 角色:焦点管理走 roving tabindex,无 Pointer Events 之外的 API 依赖。原生 <input type="date"> 亦可作免脚本兜底(桌面端为自绘日历、移动端唤起系统日期滚轮,体验不可控);ARIA grid 的读屏支持依 AT 而异,APG 对 grid 的键盘要求需真机实测。
note.en: The demo's month grid uses native buttons + ARIA grid roles throughout: focus management is roving tabindex with no API dependency beyond Pointer Events. A native <input type="date"> works as the script-free fallback (drawn calendar on desktop, system wheel on mobile — unpredictable UX); screen-reader support for ARIA grid varies by AT, and APG's grid keyboard contract needs real-device testing.

fallback.zh: 无 JS 时退化到原生 <input type="date">(或 select 年 + select 月 + 三个 select 日的组合);自绘面板定位失败时降级为触发器正下方的同宽静态面板,禁止悬浮层遮挡触发器本身。
fallback.en: Without JS degrade to native <input type="date"> (or a year select + month select + day select trio); if the drawn panel cannot position, fall back to a same-width static panel directly below the trigger — never let the floating layer cover its own trigger.

use.zh: 表单中的单一日期字段:出发日期、生效日期、账期(antd picker 默认 date 形态,调研 06§4.9)
use.en: Single date fields in forms: departure date, effective date, billing period (antd picker's default date form, research 06 §4.9)

use.zh: 跨月/跨年的日期查询:月切换翻页比下拉选年月更快定位
use.en: Date queries across months/years: month paging locates a date faster than year/month dropdowns

use.zh: 需要「不可选日期」语义的场景:已订满、过去日期、维护窗口(置灰或禁用格)
use.en: Scenarios needing 'unavailable dates': fully booked, past dates, maintenance windows (dimmed or disabled cells)

avoid.zh: 日期范围两端需要联动约束时不要复用两个单选实例——用 RangePicker 一类范围形态表达开始≤结束
avoid.en: Do not reuse two single-pickers for a constrained range — use a range form (RangePicker-style) to express start ≤ end

avoid.zh: 只需年份或月份时用 picker=year/month 精简形态,整月历是过度交互
avoid.en: When only a year or month is needed, use the picker=year/month reduced forms; a full calendar is overkill

avoid.zh: 高频录入结构化日期(如报单日期批量录入)直接键入更快——强弹日历会拖慢熟练用户
avoid.en: For high-volume structured date entry, typing beats the calendar — forcing the popup slows expert users

avoid.zh: 移动端窄屏慎用桌面式大浮层——底部抽屉式日历或系统原生滚轮更贴合触达半径
avoid.en: On narrow mobile screens, beware desktop-style large overlays — bottom-sheet calendars or native system wheels fit thumb reach better

a11y.zh: 面板网格用 role="grid"/"row"/"gridcell",星期表头 role="columnheader" 并带完整可读名称;日格是原生 button(roving tabindex:焦点落在选中日或今日,方向键 ±1/±7 移动);触发器 aria-expanded/aria-haspopup 表达展开态;Esc 关闭并把焦点还给触发器;星期与文案随 lang 同步(含 aria-label);本 demo 为自绘简化实现——未实现 APG grid 的全部键盘契约(如跨月翻页键),上线前须按 APG grid 模式补全并 AT 实测(调研 07§34/§35)。
a11y.en: The panel grid uses role="grid"/"row"/"gridcell" with weekday headers as role="columnheader" carrying full readable names; day cells are native buttons (roving tabindex: focus lands on the selected day or today; arrows move ±1/±7); the trigger exposes aria-expanded/aria-haspopup; Esc closes and returns focus to the trigger; weekdays and copy follow lang (aria-labels included). This demo is a self-drawn simplified implementation — it does not implement APG grid's full keyboard contract (e.g. paging keys across months); production must complete it per the APG grid pattern and test with real ATs (research 07 §34/§35).

goal.zh: 复刻一个自绘月历日期选择器:触发器输入框 + 展开的月历浮层(星期表头、7 列日网格、月份前后翻页、今天/清空),支持 firstDay 周一起始或周日起始、zh/en 双语、三档尺寸;点选日期即回填触发器并收起。
goal.en: Replicate a self-drawn month-calendar date picker: a trigger input + an open calendar overlay (weekday header, 7-column day grid, prev/next month paging, Today/Clear), supporting Monday/Sunday week start, zh/en bilingual copy and three size tiers; picking a day fills the trigger and collapses the panel.

acceptance.zh: 触发器三档高度严格 24/32/40px(antd DatePicker 官方文档明示的高度分档),日格尺寸随档位缩放
acceptance.en: Trigger heights are exactly 24/32/40px (the tier heights documented by antd DatePicker), with day-cell sizes scaling per tier

acceptance.zh: firstDay 重排星期表头与首行偏移;lang 同步切换月标题(2026年11月 / November 2026)、星期与按钮文案
acceptance.en: firstDay re-orders the weekday header and first-row offset; lang switches the month title (2026年11月 / November 2026), weekdays and button copy together

acceptance.zh: 面板 role=grid/row/gridcell + columnheader 结构;日格为原生 button,roving tabindex + 方向键 ±1/±7
acceptance.en: Panel structured as role=grid/row/gridcell + columnheader; day cells are native buttons with roving tabindex + arrows ±1/±7

acceptance.zh: 选中日主色底 #1677ff 白字,今日描边强调;浮层用 antd 浮层主阴影、圆角 8px、z-index 高于页面内容
acceptance.en: Selected day on primary #1677ff with white text, today outlined; the overlay uses antd's floating-layer shadow, 8px radius and a z-index above page content

acceptance.zh: Esc 关闭面板且焦点回触发器;点击外部关闭;动效约 0.2s 且尊重 prefers-reduced-motion;标注「自绘简化实现」
acceptance.en: Esc closes the panel and returns focus to the trigger; clicking outside closes; motion ~0.2s honoring prefers-reduced-motion; labeled as a 'self-drawn simplified implementation'
